leftColumn.title: New Buyer + New Seller
leftColumn.subtitle: Open Interest Increases (+1)
bullets: Both parties create brand new positions
Fresh liquidity & capital enters the market

rightColumn.title: Old Buyer + Old Seller
rightColumn.subtitle: Open Interest Decreases (-1)
bullets: Long liquidates to short who buys to cover

beats.en_narration: Volume counts every completed transaction, whereas Open Interest tallies active unclosed contracts.

beats.hindi_tts: If a new buyer buys from an existing long, or a new seller sells to an old short, OI remains unchanged.
beats.en_subtitle: If a new buyer buys from an existing long, or a new seller sells to an old short, OI remains unchanged.

leftColumn.title: Positions Expanding / Closing
leftColumn.subtitle: +1 when both open, -1 when both close
bullets: Shows whether leverage is surging or draining

rightColumn.title: Old Party + New Party
rightColumn.subtitle: Open Interest Unchanged (0)
bullets: Existing trader passes baton to new entrant
Volume increases by 1, but net OI stays flat

beats.en_narration: If a new buyer buys from an existing long, or a new seller sells to an old short, OI remains unchanged.

scenes.title: The 4 Rules of Price and OI

ui_state.sectionHeader: Murphy's 4 Rules of Price & Open Interest

cards.title: Rule 1: Price Up + OI Up → Bullish
cards.subtitle: New buyers are aggressively financing the rally with fresh money

cards.title: Rule 2: Price Up + OI Down → Bearish / Weak
cards.subtitle: Rally driven purely by short covering; upside fuel will soon dry up

cards.title: Rule 3: Price Down + OI Up → Bearish & Rule 4: Pri
